description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.
